audience: SaaS finance and billing teams who run usage-based billing and invoicing in Lago

useCases.title: Track monthly recurring and gross revenue
useCases.text: The AI reads MRR and monthly gross revenue from the analytics endpoints. You get the trend over the last months.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and the customers behind them
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by status, payment status, customer or issuing date and opens single ones. You see what is still unpaid and who owes it.

useCases.title: Check a customer's usage and subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI reads a customer's current and past usage-based billing data and their subscriptions. It can also read fees by customer, subscription or fee type.

useCases.title: Review plans, billable metrics, coupons and add-ons
useCases.text: The AI lists billing plans, billable metrics, coupons and add-ons. You get an overview of what you can bill for and discount.

useCases.title: Add a customer or record a usage event
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer, or records a usage event for a customer. The event counts toward that customer's usage and billing. It can be retried safely with a transaction id.
